codebook.name: International Crisis Behavior Data Codebook, Version 16 - ICB1 (System Level)
codebook.definition: This variable refers to the form of the outcome of an international crisis at its termination point. Form of outcome is determined by the configuration of forces operative during a crisis, and has an important bearing on the subsequent relations among the parties to a crisis. In most cases the form of outcome was common to all crisis actors. Where it was not, the form closest to consensus by the actors was coded for the entire crisis. Hence, the user should consult the coding of this variable (OUTFOR) in the Actor Level Dataset.
